title: L’Oreal: Because You’re Worth It - [Business Breakdowns, EP. 91]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: This is Matt Reustle, and today we are breaking down the personal care giant, L'Oreal.
reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle, and today we are breaking down the personal care giant, L'Oreal. Founded in the early 1900s by a French chemist, L'Oreal and its long list of iconic brands have been driving cosmetics innovation for over a century. To break down the business, I am joined by Zehrid Osmani - Head of the Long-Term Unconstrained team at Martin Currie.

key_points.text: We cover the history of brand innovation, global expansion, and all of the dynamics that played a role in L'Oreal's success.
I'd mention this episode is an excellent pairing with our Founders podcast episode 217 on Estee Lauder.
The two dominant players in the beauty market have fascinating beginnings, and their stories clearly aren't over.
